name: Genfo
description: Traditional thick barley and wheat porridge served hot with a well of spiced clarified butter (niter kibe) and fiery berbere.

name: Chechebsa
description: Torn pieces of freshly baked flatbread pan-fried in seasoned berbere and spiced butter, served with cooling fresh yogurt.

name: Shiro Wot
description: Velvety spiced chickpea and split pea flour stew, slow-cooked in a traditional clay pot and served bubbling hot with teff injera.

name: Misir Wot
description: Red split lentils slow-simmered in rich berbere sauce, fragrant garlic, ginger, and caramelized onions.

name: Doro Wot
description: The celebratory crown of Ethiopian feasts: tender chicken leg simmered for hours in rich berbere sauce with hard-boiled farm eggs and ayib.

name: Tibs
description: Tender lean beef cubes sautéed on high heat in a sizzling cast-iron skillet with red onions, rosemary, and sliced fresh jalapeño peppers.

name: Dulet
description: Finely minced lean beef, liver, and tripe seasoned with fiery mitmita spice, clarified spiced butter, and fresh diced green peppers.

name: Beyaynetu
description: A colorful feast platter featuring an assortment of vegetarian and vegan stews, lentils, split peas, and garden greens atop teff injera.

name: Gomen Kitfo
description: Finely chopped highland collard greens sautéed with seasoned minced beef, niter kibe, and mitmita, served with house-made ayib cheese.

name: Fasolia
description: Tender string green beans and sweet carrots gently sautéed with caramelized onions, garlic, and Ethiopian highland herbs.
